crypto_profile.entropy: 128 random bits after the accepted canonical mapping; salt/verifier uniqueness does not prove generated-code uniqueness. Use bounded transient canonical collision detection.

crypto_profile.frame_mechanics: Use fixed unambiguous versioned serialization and the native hasher; no ambiguous concatenation, generic-user purpose assumption, fast global code digest or copied KDF.
